question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"imperiously."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Imperiously"** means in a commanding or dominant manner. (आदेशात्मक या प्रभावशाली ढंग से)

 
 
• **Example**: *The CEO spoke **imperiously**__ to his employees, expecting them to follow his every order.*
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word which means in a dominating manner.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

To my utter __astonishment,__ the little dark boy was striding __imperiously__ up and down the lawn while the white youngster walked ______ (3) ______ behind him. “Get me a banana!” The little boy ran ______ (4) ______ the house and ______ (5) ______ shortly.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Greedily",** means in a way that shows a strong desire for more wealth or possessions. (लोभ से)
 
• **"Softly"**, means in a gentle or quiet manner. (हलके से, कोमलता से)
 
• **"Usually"**, means normally or typically. (हमेशा के ढंग से; बहुधा, सामान्‍यतया)
